{"metadata":{"description":"Task dispatcher for DeepSeek Harness: use TickTick (滴答清单) as the daily task dispatcher — a cordis timer pulls today's due tasks, writes them to the task file, and notifies (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); optional auto-execute with result receipts","id":"gh:1346360742","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-task-dispatcher","slug":"zhengjy01/dsh-task-dispatcher","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","ticktick"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Task dispatcher for DeepSeek Harness: use TickTick (滴答清单) as the daily task dispatcher — a cordis ti"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"mer pulls today's due tasks, writes them to the task file, and notifies (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"/ macOS); optional auto-execute with result receipts"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-task-dispatcher — TickTick daily task dispatcher"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Use TickTick (滴答清单) as DSH's daily task dispatcher: a cordis timer pulls today's due tasks from the "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"configured source list (default `5️⃣AI`; point it at `In progress` to dispatch from the "doing" list"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"), writes them to today's task file, and notifies via **WeChat (ClawBot)**, flomo, or macOS (configu"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"rable). The agent reads the file, works through the items, and writes results back to TickTick with "},{"id":"p3s5","text":"`ticktick_complete`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Reuses the already-installed `dsh-ticktick` plugin (its data layer + OAuth credentials in `~/.dsh/"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"dsh-ticktick.json`) — no duplicate configuration."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Interval dispatch**: cordis `ctx.interval` polls every minute and dispatches when the configured"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" interval (minutes) has elapsed; 0 disables the timer; `dispatcher_run` dispatches manually anytime."},{"id":"p6s3","text":"
- **Task source**: default the `5️⃣AI` list (set it to `In progress` to dispatch from the "doing" l"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ist; `projectName` / `projectId` configurable); `dueMode=today` pulls due-today/overdue + undated, `"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"dueMode=all` pulls all incomplete.
- **Today task file**: writes a Markdown checklist (default `~/.d"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"sh/dsh-task-dispatcher/today-tasks.md`).
- **Execution-result receipts (`notifyResult`, on by defaul"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"t)**: every auto-executed task pushes a SHORT outcome message (`OK`/`FAIL` + title + a one-line resu"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"lt, or the failure reason such as a worker timeout) as soon as its worker settles, plus a compact ba"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"tch tally when a pass runs more than one task - a run reports back by itself instead of relying on t"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"he worker calling `dispatcher_report`. The summary is the worker's **stdout final answer** (progress"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"/reasoning go to stderr), stripped of ANSI and the `DONE` marker and capped at 220 characters.
- **N"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"otify on change only**: `notifyWechat` (WeChat, relayed through the local DSH-WeChatClawBot gateway;"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" the recipient is auto-detected) + `notifyFlomo` (reuses `~/.dsh/dsh-flomo.json`) + `notifyMac` (osa"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"script); a repeated pull with no new tasks stays silent.
- **WeChat notifications (ClawBot)**: the p"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"lugin POSTs the text to the local gateway `/send` (default `http://127.0.0.1:51235`), which relays i"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"t to the WeChat account that scanned the QR code. The plugin never talks to WeChat directly and stor"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"es no WeChat credentials. The recipient defaults to the `userId` recorded in the ClawBot state dir ("},{"id":"p6s18","text":"`~/.dsh-wechat`, override with `DSH_WECHAT_HOME`) under `accounts/<botId>.json`, or can be set expli"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"citly with `wechatTo`; long bodies are split into 1200-character chunks. An unavailable channel only"},{"id":"p6s20","text":" marks that channel as failed — it never fails the dispatch.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Requires **DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.1.5-rc.1** (declared as `dsh.engines.dsh` in the package manifest, s"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"o the DSH plugin marketplace can report it) and is verified against **0.1.5-rc.1**. This build carri"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"es the DSH 0.1.5 adaptations: the strict tool-result contract (lossless-JSON snapshot, `additionalPr"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"operties: false` schema validation, and `output.render` returning `ContentBlock[]`) plus executable "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"resolution that survives a launchd-started host whose `PATH` is only `/usr/bin:/bin`. **Since this v"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ersion** the `peerDependencies` range explicitly declares compatibility with **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** (`^0"},{"id":"p8s7","text":".2.0-rc.2` is now included), so no compatibility warning appears on 0.2.0-rc.2. No functional change"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"2.0-rc.2` is now included), so no compatibility warning appears on 0.2.0-rc.2. No functional change."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> The shape is **install → restart → confirm it loaded**. Every step states the expected result, so "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"you can tell success from failure."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. **Install the plugin**: run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-dispatcher` in a terminal.
Exp"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ected: the command exits cleanly and `dsh-task-dispatcher` shows up in the dependencies of `~/.dsh/p"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"rofiles/web/package.json`.
2. **Restart DSH**: restart `dsh web` (sidebar “restart”, or re-run the s"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ame start command).
Expected: the GUI comes back with no plugin-loading errors in the startup output"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"me start command).
Expected: the GUI comes back with no plugin-loading errors in the startup output."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> 📷 **【Screenshot slot 2】proves the plugin actually installed**
> How to capture: in the terminal, s"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"top right after step 1's command finishes (or on the DSH startup lines after the restart); crop: the"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" terminal window
> Redact: **local absolute paths, your username, any token**
> To fill in: save the"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" shot to `docs/images/dsh-task-dispatcher-01-installed.png`, then replace this whole block with
> `!"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"/images/dsh-task-dispatcher-01-installed.png`, then replace this whole block with
> `!After install`"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"3. **Confirm it loaded**: ask the agent to run `dispatcher_status` (or check that “Task dispatcher” "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"appears on the settings page).
Expected: output starts with `插件状态：已启用` / status “enabled” and lists "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"the source list, pull interval and notification channels."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Enable & configure"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"4. **Open the settings page**: DSH Web → **Settings** → expand the **“Task dispatcher”** card.
Expec"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ted: you see the master switch, pull interval, task source, notification channels and auto-execute b"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ou see the master switch, pull interval, task source, notification channels and auto-execute blocks."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> 📷 **【Screenshot slot 4】proves where the settings live (the step people get stuck on)**
> How to ca"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"pture: Settings → stop on the top half of the expanded “Task dispatcher” card (master switch + pull "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"interval + source list)
> Redact: workspace paths / list names if they carry personal information
> "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"To fill in: save the shot to `docs/images/dsh-task-dispatcher-02-settings.png`, then replace this wh"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ole block with
> `!Task dispatcher in Settings`"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"5. **Adjust what you need**: set the **task source** (default `5️⃣AI`; use `In progress` to dispatch"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" from the “doing” list), the **pull interval** (0 disables the timer), the **notification channels**"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" (WeChat ClawBot / flomo / macOS; WeChat is off unless you switch it on) and **auto-execute** (each "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"task then runs in its own headless session).
Expected: the status line refreshes after saving and `d"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ispatcher_status` reports the same values.
